audit.why: Both layers agree and match the data: Akshan owns levels 1 through 5 on Avengerang chip and wall-latch swings, the lane levels at 6 once Petrifying Gaze can turn his commit, and it stays even after. That fits the 49.28% Emerald+ figure over 69 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and cooldown line says 'fight only while Heroic Swing is down' without ever saying how long down is.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and Avengerang is 9/8/7/6/5s. The gap between an 18s engage tool and a 9s poke tool is the whole shape of the early lane, and neither number appears anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing and Avengerang cooldowns now stated in the mid text, the cooldown-windows block and the key-interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dirty Fighting (P) is never mentioned as a shield, and the full layer's phase whys are Aatrox text describing Cassiopeia winning stages that the same rows mark as Akshan's.
audit.why: Dirty Fighting shields Akshan on every third hit from his attacks and abilities against a champion. That directly changes the all-in maths and it also punishes exactly the thing Cassiopeia wants to do by default — spray unprimed Twin Fang chip, which just tops his shield up. The two interactions the page does get right are Miasma grounding Heroic Swing and Petrifying Gaze cutting Comeuppance; the Gaze caveat that it only stuns enemies facing you matters here because a swinging Akshan turns his back.
audit.corrected: Shield added to wants.foe and to the relevant don't; all seven phase whys rewritten so they describe the side the row actually names.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1], dosFull[2], dontsFull[1] and dontsFull[2] have bodies that do not describe their own headings, and tradeGood is a verbatim clone of the Aatrox page.
audit.why: dosFull[1] is headed 'Ground his sidestep lanes with W' but its body is the Aatrox trade line. dosFull[2] is headed 'Win extended exchanges with E-spam' but its body says Akshan spends Heroic Swing early. dontsFull[1] is headed 'E-spam unpoisoned targets at range' but its body is about Miasma. dontsFull[2] is headed "Forget R's stun wins any face-to-face" but its body is a duplicate of tradeBad.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to its own heading, and tradeGood rewritten to Akshan's actual cooldown pattern.

edits.before: Stack his passive's third hit with Avengerang and autos without stepping into your Noxious Blast range
edits.after: Stack Dirty Fighting to its third hit for the shield, chipping with Avengerang from outside Noxious Blast range

edits.before: Levels 4-5 still favour his skirmish — he opens from a wall-latch swing and his passive's third hit out-front-loads my ramp — so I trade on his cooldowns, not his terms: wait for his Heroic Swing to be spent or his Avengerang on the return, then prime with Q and chain Twin Fang off the poison refund. At 6 the lane levels: if he swings in or starts Comeuppance, I turn into him and Petrifying Gaze — but only while he's facing me, or it just slows — then poison and Twin Fang him down. The one trade I'll always take is when he lands in my Miasma: it grounds his swing and he's a stationary marksman in melee range of my E.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 still favour his skirmish — he opens from a wall-latch swing and his passive's third hit out-front-loads my ramp — so I trade on his cooldowns, not his terms: Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1, so step up once it's spent or catch the Avengerang on its return, then prime with Q and chain Twin Fang off the poison refund. At 6 the lane levels: if he swings in or starts Comeuppance, I turn into him and Petrifying Gaze — but only while he's facing me, or it just slows — then poison and Twin Fang him down. The one trade I'll always take is when he lands in my Miasma: it grounds his swing and he's a stationary marksman in melee range of my E.

edits.before: Q poke on his last-hits starts the poison economy — you're annoying now and lethal in ten minutes.
edits.after: One Avengerang chips you on the way out and back; your single Q has no poison primed to answer it.

edits.before: W Miasma online — the grounding zone deletes dash kits from the matchup while it sits there.
edits.after: Heroic Swing lands — he latches a wall and fires while moving from an angle you can't pre-aim.

edits.before: Full kit: Q poison into E-spam is real DPS already. Twin Fangs cost almost nothing on poisoned targets.
edits.after: His passive's third hit plus Avengerang out-front-loads your ramp; Twin Fang hasn't scaled into it yet.

edits.before: The DPS treadmill builds — poison, E, E, E. Drop W on his approach path and Heroic Swing stops being scary.
edits.after: He trades on wall-latch swings with Heroic Swing back every 18s — your ramp still can't punish the poke.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze online — the face-check stun flips every all-in: they engage, you R, they die in the E-spam.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze flips his all-in — it stuns mid-swing and cuts Comeuppance, but only while he is facing you.

edits.before: Seraph's or Liandry's spike — your sustained DPS now out-damages every melee top in an extended exchange.
edits.after: His poke removes half-bars and he roams on camouflage while your first item is still buying the DPS spike.

edits.before: Late game you out-DPS carries while walking — speed from level scaling, R the dive, E-spam whatever's stunned.
edits.after: Ramping Twin Fang out-DPSes his poke and Miasma grounds Heroic Swing, but his threat moves to map picks.

edits.before: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as he steps at you, and walk the grounded zone's edge while the fangs finish the math.
edits.after: Q-poison him as the Avengerang returns, chain Twin Fang on the poison timer, and drop Miasma on the wall he wants to latch for the exit.

edits.before: From 6 you win every face-to-face — R the engage, ground the exit, E-spam the body. Take plates and force river fights where your DPS is unmatched.
edits.after: From 6 the lane levels — turn into his swing and Petrifying Gaze only while he faces you, then poison and chain Twin Fang before Comeuppance fires.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Miasma is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1, 12s maxed): matchup-defining — his engage and his escape both, so step up only while it is down. - Avengerang is back every 9s and his passive shields him on every third hit, so unprimed chip funds him.

edits.before: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as he steps at you, and walk the grounded zone's edge while the fangs finish the math.
edits.after: Miasma on the wall he wants to latch grounds Heroic Swing outright — a grounded Akshan is a stationary marksman standing inside your poison cloud.

edits.before: Akshan spends Heroic Swing early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Ramping Twin Fang beats his burst poke past two items — prime with Q and never let up.

edits.before: Miasma is your only anti-engage tool — wasting it on spacing chip leaves the dash window wide open.
edits.after: Unpoisoned Twin Fang is chip damage that just feeds his Dirty Fighting shield every third hit.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Heroic Swing range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you — Akshan swinging past turns his back, and all he eats is the slow.

edits.before: Track Akshan’s Heroic Swing: His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, his engage and his escape both. Miasma grounds it — step up on its downtime.

edits.after: Good trade: Q-poison him as the Avengerang returns, chain Twin Fang on the poison timer, and drop Miasma on the wall he wants to latch for the exit. Great trade: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit immediately. Bad trade: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Heroic Swing range with Miasma on cooldown.

notes: Going Rogue (W) is camouflage, not stealth-with-a-reveal — the kit text says he loses it quickly when not in brush or near terrain, and Cassiopeia has nothing in her kit that reveals him. The content layer handles this correctly (control wards, don't facecheck) so I left it. I did not touch the numeric phase ratings; see the note on the Akali file for why.
